title: Sending and Missions
definition: Sending and Missions is the Church's participation in Christ's commission by sending workers, supporting Gospel labor, and proclaiming Christ among all peoples.
summary: The Church sends and supports Gospel ministry for the glory of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His witnesses to the nations with the message of repentance and forgiveness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sending and Missions teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church sends and supports gospel ministry for the glory of christ.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Sending and Missions calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let sending and missions move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
